title: FBNQuest Capital successfully completes ₦64.8bn private placement
text:
FBNQuest Capital, a subsidiary of FBN Holdings, has successfully completed a ₦64.8 billion private placement. The offering involved the issuance of 26.5 billion ordinary shares at ₦2.43 per share, attracting significant investment from private individuals and corporate entities. Key shareholders include Abdulganiyu Olajide Adeola, Archetype Energy Services Limited, and CardinalStone Asset Management Limited.

The lender, which provides real estate construction finance and personal banking services, disclosed this in a regulatory filing signed by the bank’s Executive Director, John Okonkwo, on Wednesday. According to the bank, the private placement involved 26,562,647,265 ordinary shares of 50 kobo each, issued at ₦2.43 per share.
Abdulganiyu Olajide Adeola emerged as the bank’s largest shareholder, holding 6,995,884,774 shares, representing 19.05 per cent of the bank. Archetype Energy Services Limited holds 6,333,476,332 shares, representing 17.25 per cent, while CardinalStone Asset Management Limited holds 4,011,757,786 shares, equivalent to 10.93 per cent. The disclosure followed the completion of the private placement, which increased the listed investors’ holdings in the bank to significant levels.

At its annual general meeting in May, Abbey Mortgage Bank also obtained shareholders’ approval to establish a ₦100 billion debt issuance programme.
The bank’s total assets stood at ₦222.4 billion as of March 2026, up from ₦165.8 billion at the end of December 2025, according to its latest earnings report.
